items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin slides under $84,000 as $550 million in bets get liquidated
items.summary: Traders betting on higher prices took the brunt of the forced selling, while oil climbed on Iranian tanker attacks. Fed minutes are due later Wednesday.

items.title: Bitcoin’s recovery stalls just short of rescuing its last underwater cohort
items.summary: Yearly buyer cohorts and U.S. spot ETF investors offer a map of potential support and resistance as bitcoin retreats below $84,000.

items.title: Liquidations jump to $547 million as oil rally hits crypto market
items.summary: Bitcoin fell below $84,000 as oil climbed on Iranian tanker attacks, while smaller tokens fell harder and liquidations rose to $547 million.

items.title: Rain is seeking a national trust bank charter to bypass third-party banks
items.summary: The stablecoin payments company’s proposed New York trust bank would custody digital assets and dollars, manage stablecoin reserves and issue and redeem dollar-backed tokens.

items.title: Robinhood adds bitcoin worth $25 million to its balance sheet
items.summary: Robinhood has added bitcoin worth $25 million to its balance sheet, senior vice president and general manager of crypto and international, told the Starting Block Wednesday.
